import math

enum Kind
    Seg
    Lazy
    Fen
    Rfen
    Sparse
    Sqrt
    Persist
    Grid

enum Operation
    Sum
    Min
    Max
    Gcd

class Span(int left, int right)
class Aggregate(sum := 0, minimum := 0, maximum := 0)
class Counts(visited := 0, covered := 0, pushes := 0)
class Answer(value := 0, visited := 0)
class Report(string text, int[] values)
class Segment(Operation operation := Operation.Sum, size := 0)
    int[] nodes := []
    max_node := 0
class LazyNode(value := Aggregate(), int | none assignment := none, addition := 0)
class LazyTree(size := 0)
    LazyNode[] nodes := []
class Bit(int[] tree := [])
class Fenwick(int[] values := [], bit := Bit())
class RangeFenwick(first := Bit(), second := Bit())
class Sparse(int[] values := [])
    int[][] minima := []
    int[][] maxima := []
class Sqrt(block := 1, int[] values := [])
    int[] tags := []
    int[] sums := []
class Split(int[] cells, int[] blocks)
class BlockAnswer(int sum, int whole, int cells)
class Node(int left, int right, int value)
class Persistent(size := 0)
    Node[] position := []
    Node[] counts := []
    int[] roots := []
    int[] prefixes := []
    int[] domain := []
class Grid(height := 0, width := 0)
    int[][] tree := []
class Lab(int[] values)
    original := values
    built := array(8, fill = false)
    segment := Segment()
    lazy := LazyTree()
    fen := Fenwick()
    rfen := RangeFenwick()
    sparse := Sparse()
    sqrt := Sqrt()
    persist := Persistent()
    grid := Grid()

Kind[] kinds()
    return [Kind.Seg, Kind.Lazy, Kind.Fen, Kind.Rfen, Kind.Sparse, Kind.Sqrt, Kind.Persist, Kind.Grid]

string kind_text(Kind kind)
    match kind
        Kind.Seg
            return "SEG"
        Kind.Lazy
            return "LAZY"
        Kind.Fen
            return "FEN"
        Kind.Rfen
            return "RFEN"
        Kind.Sparse
            return "SPARSE"
        Kind.Sqrt
            return "SQRT"
        Kind.Persist
            return "PERSIST"
        Kind.Grid
            return "GRID"

int kind_index(Kind kind)
    names := kinds()
    for index := names.indices()[]
        if names[index] == kind
            return int(index)
    return 0

string operation_text(Operation operation, lowercase := false)
    match operation
        Operation.Sum
            return if lowercase then "sum" else "SUM"
        Operation.Min
            return if lowercase then "min" else "MIN"
        Operation.Max
            return if lowercase then "max" else "MAX"
        Operation.Gcd
            return if lowercase then "gcd" else "GCD"

int gcd(int a, int b)
    a = math.abs(a)
    b = math.abs(b)
    while b != 0
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

int integer_sqrt(int value)
    root := 1
    while (root + 1) * (root + 1) <= value
        root += 1
    return root

int lowbit(int value)
    result := 1
    while value % 2 == 0
        value /= 2
        result *= 2
    return result

string numbers(const int[] values)
    string[] words := []
    for value := values[]
        words = words.append(string(value))
    return words.join(" ")

int[] parsed(const string[] words)
    int[] result := []
    for word := words[]
        result = result.append(int(word))
    return result

string aggregate_text(const Aggregate value)
    return "sum={value.sum} min={value.minimum} max={value.maximum}"

Aggregate aggregate(const int[] values)
    return Aggregate(values.sum(), values.min(), values.max())

Aggregate combine(const Aggregate a, const Aggregate b)
    return Aggregate(a.sum + b.sum, math.min(a.minimum, b.minimum), math.max(a.maximum, b.maximum))

bool covered(Span wanted, Span node)
    return wanted.left <= node.left and node.right <= wanted.right

int operate(Operation operation, int a, int b)
    match operation
        Operation.Sum
            return a + b
        Operation.Min
            return math.min(a, b)
        Operation.Max
            return math.max(a, b)
        Operation.Gcd
            return gcd(a, b)

void fill_bounds(Span[] &bounds, int node, Span span)
    bounds[node] = span
    if span.left < span.right
        middle := (span.left + span.right) / 2
        fill_bounds(&bounds, 2 * node, Span(span.left, middle))
        fill_bounds(&bounds, 2 * node + 1, Span(middle + 1, span.right))

Span[] node_bounds(int size)
    bounds := array(nat(4 * size), fill = Span(0, -1))
    fill_bounds(&bounds, 1, Span(0, size - 1))
    return bounds

void segment_build(Segment &tree, int node, Span span, const int[] values)
    tree.max_node = math.max(tree.max_node, node)
    if span.left == span.right
        value := values[span.left]
        tree.nodes[node] = if tree.operation == Operation.Gcd then math.abs(value) else value
        return
    middle := (span.left + span.right) / 2
    segment_build(&tree, 2 * node, Span(span.left, middle), values)
    segment_build(&tree, 2 * node + 1, Span(middle + 1, span.right), values)
    tree.nodes[node] = operate(tree.operation, tree.nodes[2 * node], tree.nodes[2 * node + 1])

Answer segment_query(const Segment tree, int node, Span span, Span wanted)
    if covered(wanted, span)
        return Answer(tree.nodes[node], 1)
    middle := (span.left + span.right) / 2
    Answer result
    if wanted.right <= middle
        result = segment_query(tree, 2 * node, Span(span.left, middle), wanted)
    elif wanted.left > middle
        result = segment_query(tree, 2 * node + 1, Span(middle + 1, span.right), wanted)
    else
        first := segment_query(tree, 2 * node, Span(span.left, middle), wanted)
        second := segment_query(tree, 2 * node + 1, Span(middle + 1, span.right), wanted)
        result = Answer(operate(tree.operation, first.value, second.value), first.visited + second.visited)
    result.visited += 1
    return result

int segment_update(Segment &tree, int node, Span span, int index, int value)
    if span.left == span.right
        tree.nodes[node] = if tree.operation == Operation.Gcd then math.abs(value) else value
        return 1
    middle := (span.left + span.right) / 2
    int visited
    if index <= middle
        visited = segment_update(&tree, 2 * node, Span(span.left, middle), index, value)
    else
        visited = segment_update(&tree, 2 * node + 1, Span(middle + 1, span.right), index, value)
    tree.nodes[node] = operate(tree.operation, tree.nodes[2 * node], tree.nodes[2 * node + 1])
    return visited + 1

void lazy_pull(LazyTree &tree, int node)
    tree.nodes[node].value = combine(tree.nodes[2 * node].value, tree.nodes[2 * node + 1].value)

void lazy_build(LazyTree &tree, int node, Span span, const int[] values)
    if span.left == span.right
        value := values[span.left]
        tree.nodes[node].value = Aggregate(value, value, value)
        return
    middle := (span.left + span.right) / 2
    lazy_build(&tree, 2 * node, Span(span.left, middle), values)
    lazy_build(&tree, 2 * node + 1, Span(middle + 1, span.right), values)
    lazy_pull(&tree, node)

void lazy_apply(LazyTree &tree, int node, Span span, int value, bool assign)
    length := span.right - span.left + 1
    if assign
        tree.nodes[node].value = Aggregate(value * length, value, value)
    else
        tree.nodes[node].value.sum += value * length
        tree.nodes[node].value.minimum += value
        tree.nodes[node].value.maximum += value
    if span.left < span.right
        if assign
            tree.nodes[node].assignment = value
            tree.nodes[node].addition = 0
        else
            tree.nodes[node].addition += value

void lazy_push(LazyTree &tree, int node, Span span, Counts &counts)
    saved := tree.nodes[node]
    assigned := false
    assignment := 0
    match saved.assignment
        int value
            assigned = true
            assignment = value
        none
            assigned = false
    if not assigned and saved.addition == 0
        return
    counts.pushes += 1
    middle := (span.left + span.right) / 2
    for: 0 <= side < 2
        child := if side == 0 then Span(span.left, middle) else Span(middle + 1, span.right)
        if assigned
            lazy_apply(&tree, 2 * node + side, child, assignment, true)
        if saved.addition != 0
            lazy_apply(&tree, 2 * node + side, child, saved.addition, false)
    tree.nodes[node].assignment = none
    tree.nodes[node].addition = 0

void lazy_update(LazyTree &tree, int node, Span span, Span wanted, int value, bool assign, Counts &counts)
    counts.visited += 1
    if covered(wanted, span)
        counts.covered += 1
        lazy_apply(&tree, node, span, value, assign)
        return
    lazy_push(&tree, node, span, &counts)
    middle := (span.left + span.right) / 2
    if wanted.left <= middle
        lazy_update(&tree, 2 * node, Span(span.left, middle), wanted, value, assign, &counts)
    if wanted.right > middle
        lazy_update(&tree, 2 * node + 1, Span(middle + 1, span.right), wanted, value, assign, &counts)
    lazy_pull(&tree, node)

Aggregate lazy_query(LazyTree &tree, int node, Span span, Span wanted, Counts &counts)
    counts.visited += 1
    if covered(wanted, span)
        return tree.nodes[node].value
    lazy_push(&tree, node, span, &counts)
    middle := (span.left + span.right) / 2
    if wanted.right <= middle
        return lazy_query(&tree, 2 * node, Span(span.left, middle), wanted, &counts)
    if wanted.left > middle
        return lazy_query(&tree, 2 * node + 1, Span(middle + 1, span.right), wanted, &counts)
    first := lazy_query(&tree, 2 * node, Span(span.left, middle), wanted, &counts)
    second := lazy_query(&tree, 2 * node + 1, Span(middle + 1, span.right), wanted, &counts)
    return combine(first, second)

int bit_add(Bit &bit, int position, int value)
    visited := 0
    while position < int(#bit.tree)
        bit.tree[position] += value
        visited += 1
        position += lowbit(position)
    return visited

Bit new_bit(const int[] values)
    result := Bit(array(#values + 1, fill = 0))
    for index := values.indices()[]
        bit_add(&result, int(index) + 1, values[index])
    return result

Answer bit_prefix(const Bit bit, int position)
    result := Answer()
    while position > 0
        result.value += bit.tree[position]
        result.visited += 1
        position -= lowbit(position)
    return result

Answer bit_range(const Bit bit, Span span)
    first := bit_prefix(bit, span.right + 1)
    second := bit_prefix(bit, span.left)
    return Answer(first.value - second.value, first.visited + second.visited)

Answer bit_lower(const Bit bit, int remaining)
    size := int(#bit.tree) - 1
    step := 1
    while step * 2 <= size
        step *= 2
    result := Answer()
    while step > 0
        if result.value + step <= size
            result.visited += 1
            value := bit.tree[result.value + step]
            if value < remaining
                remaining -= value
                result.value += step
        step /= 2
    if result.value == size
        result.value = -1
    return result

RangeFenwick new_rfen(const int[] values)
    int[] differences := []
    int[] weighted := []
    for index := values.indices()[]
        difference := values[index] - (if index == 0 then 0 else values[index - 1])
        differences = differences.append(difference)
        weighted = weighted.append(int(index) * difference)
    return RangeFenwick(new_bit(differences), new_bit(weighted))

int rfen_add(RangeFenwick &tree, Span span, int value)
    visited := bit_add(&tree.first, span.left + 1, value)
    visited += bit_add(&tree.first, span.right + 2, -value)
    visited += bit_add(&tree.second, span.left + 1, value * span.left)
    visited += bit_add(&tree.second, span.right + 2, -value * (span.right + 1))
    return visited

Answer rfen_prefix(const RangeFenwick tree, int position)
    first := bit_prefix(tree.first, position)
    second := bit_prefix(tree.second, position)
    return Answer(position * first.value - second.value, first.visited + second.visited)

Answer rfen_range(const RangeFenwick tree, Span span)
    first := rfen_prefix(tree, span.right + 1)
    second := rfen_prefix(tree, span.left)
    return Answer(first.value - second.value, first.visited + second.visited)

Sparse new_sparse(const int[] values)
    result := Sparse(values)
    int[] indices := int(values.indices())
    result.minima = [indices]
    result.maxima = [indices]
    width := 2
    while width <= int(#values)
        level := int(#result.minima) - 1
        int[] lows := []
        int[] highs := []
        for: 0 <= index <= int(#values) - width
            a := result.minima[level][index]
            b := result.minima[level][index + width / 2]
            lows = lows.append(if values[a] <= values[b] then a else b)
            a = result.maxima[level][index]
            b = result.maxima[level][index + width / 2]
            highs = highs.append(if values[a] >= values[b] then a else b)
        result.minima = result.minima.append(lows)
        result.maxima = result.maxima.append(highs)
        width *= 2
    return result

Report sparse_query(const Sparse tree, Span span)
    level := 0
    width := 1
    while width * 2 <= span.right - span.left + 1
        width *= 2
        level += 1
    ending := span.right - width + 1
    a := tree.minima[level][span.left]
    b := tree.minima[level][ending]
    low := if tree.values[a] <= tree.values[b] then a else b
    a = tree.maxima[level][span.left]
    b = tree.maxima[level][ending]
    high := if tree.values[a] >= tree.values[b] then a else b
    return Report("min={tree.values[low]} minpos={low} max={tree.values[high]} maxpos={high} level={level}", [tree.values[low], tree.values[high]])

Sqrt new_sqrt(const int[] values, int block)
    result := Sqrt(block, values)
    blocks := (int(#values) + block - 1) / block
    result.tags = array(nat(blocks), fill = 0)
    result.sums = array(nat(blocks), fill = 0)
    for index := values.indices()[]
        result.sums[int(index) / block] += values[index]
    return result

Split split_blocks(const Sqrt tree, Span span)
    first := span.left / tree.block
    last := span.right / tree.block
    int[] cells := []
    int[] blocks := []
    for: span.left <= index <= span.right
        block := index / tree.block
        if block == first or block == last
            cells = cells.append(index)
    for: first + 1 <= block < last
        blocks = blocks.append(block)
    return Split(cells, blocks)

BlockAnswer sqrt_add(Sqrt &tree, Span span, int value)
    split := split_blocks(tree, span)
    for index := split.cells[]
        tree.values[index] += value
        tree.sums[index / tree.block] += value
    for block := split.blocks[]
        tree.tags[block] += value
        tree.sums[block] += value * tree.block
    return BlockAnswer(0, int(#split.blocks), int(#split.cells))

BlockAnswer sqrt_query(const Sqrt tree, Span span)
    split := split_blocks(tree, span)
    int[] terms := []
    for index := split.cells[]
        terms = terms.append(tree.values[index] + tree.tags[index / tree.block])
    for block := split.blocks[]
        terms = terms.append(tree.sums[block])
    return BlockAnswer(terms.sum(), int(#split.blocks), int(#split.cells))

int pool_build(Node[] &pool, const int[] values, Span span)
    Node node
    if span.left == span.right
        node = Node(-1, -1, values[span.left])
    else
        middle := (span.left + span.right) / 2
        left := pool_build(&pool, values, Span(span.left, middle))
        right := pool_build(&pool, values, Span(middle + 1, span.right))
        node = Node(left, right, pool[left].value + pool[right].value)
    index := int(#pool)
    pool = pool.append(node)
    return index

int pool_fork(Node[] &pool, int root, Span span, int index, int value, bool increment)
    node := pool[root]
    if span.left == span.right
        node.value = if increment then node.value + value else value
    else
        middle := (span.left + span.right) / 2
        if index <= middle
            node.left = pool_fork(&pool, node.left, Span(span.left, middle), index, value, increment)
        else
            node.right = pool_fork(&pool, node.right, Span(middle + 1, span.right), index, value, increment)
        node.value = pool[node.left].value + pool[node.right].value
    created := int(#pool)
    pool = pool.append(node)
    return created

Answer pool_query(const Node[] pool, int root, Span span, Span wanted)
    node := pool[root]
    if covered(wanted, span)
        return Answer(node.value, 1)
    middle := (span.left + span.right) / 2
    Answer result
    if wanted.right <= middle
        result = pool_query(pool, node.left, Span(span.left, middle), wanted)
    elif wanted.left > middle
        result = pool_query(pool, node.right, Span(middle + 1, span.right), wanted)
    else
        first := pool_query(pool, node.left, Span(span.left, middle), wanted)
        second := pool_query(pool, node.right, Span(middle + 1, span.right), wanted)
        result = Answer(first.value + second.value, first.visited + second.visited)
    result.visited += 1
    return result

int[] unique_sorted(const int[] values)
    int[] result := []
    for value := values.sorted()[]
        if #result == 0
            result = result.append(value)
        elif result[-1] != value
            result = result.append(value)
    return result

int rank_of(const int[] values, int target)
    left := 0
    right := int(#values)
    while left < right
        middle := (left + right) / 2
        if values[middle] < target
            left = middle + 1
        else
            right = middle
    return left

Persistent new_persistent(const int[] values)
    result := Persistent(int(#values))
    result.roots = [pool_build(&result.position, values, Span(0, result.size - 1))]
    result.domain = unique_sorted(values)
    span := Span(0, int(#result.domain) - 1)
    zero := array(#result.domain, fill = 0)
    result.prefixes = [pool_build(&result.counts, zero, span)]
    for value := values[]
        source := result.prefixes[-1]
        root := pool_fork(&result.counts, source, span, rank_of(result.domain, value), 1, true)
        result.prefixes = result.prefixes.append(root)
    return result

Answer persistent_kth(const Persistent tree, Span span, int k)
    upper := tree.prefixes[span.right + 1]
    lower := tree.prefixes[span.left]
    left := 0
    right := int(#tree.domain) - 1
    visited := 1
    while left < right
        middle := (left + right) / 2
        a := tree.counts[upper].left
        b := tree.counts[lower].left
        count := tree.counts[a].value - tree.counts[b].value
        if k <= count
            upper = a
            lower = b
            right = middle
        else
            k -= count
            upper = tree.counts[upper].right
            lower = tree.counts[lower].right
            left = middle + 1
        visited += 1
    return Answer(tree.domain[left], visited)

int grid_add(Grid &grid, int row, int column, int value)
    visited := 0
    y := row + 1
    while y <= grid.height
        x := column + 1
        while x <= grid.width
            grid.tree[y][x] += value
            visited += 1
            x += lowbit(x)
        y += lowbit(y)
    return visited

Grid new_grid(int height, int width, const int[] values)
    result := Grid(height, width)
    row := array(nat(width + 1), fill = 0)
    result.tree = array(nat(height + 1), fill = row)
    for index := values.indices()[]
        grid_add(&result, int(index) / width, int(index) % width, values[index])
    return result

Answer grid_prefix(const Grid grid, int row, int column)
    result := Answer()
    while row > 0
        x := column
        while x > 0
            result.value += grid.tree[row][x]
            result.visited += 1
            x -= lowbit(x)
        row -= lowbit(row)
    return result

string build_array(Lab &lab, Kind kind, Operation operation, int block)
    size := int(#lab.values)
    lab.built[kind_index(kind)] = true
    if kind == Kind.Seg
        tree := Segment(operation, size)
        tree.nodes = array(nat(4 * size), fill = 0)
        segment_build(&tree, 1, Span(0, size - 1), lab.values)
        lab.segment = tree
        return "SEG BUILD " + operation_text(operation) + " nodes={2 * size - 1} maxnode={tree.max_node} root={tree.nodes[1]}"
    elif kind == Kind.Lazy
        tree := LazyTree(size)
        tree.nodes = array(nat(4 * size), fill = LazyNode())
        lazy_build(&tree, 1, Span(0, size - 1), lab.values)
        lab.lazy = tree
        return "LAZY BUILD nodes={2 * size - 1} " + aggregate_text(tree.nodes[1].value)
    elif kind == Kind.Fen
        lab.fen = Fenwick(lab.values, new_bit(lab.values))
        return "FEN BUILD n={size} total=" + string(lab.values.sum())
    elif kind == Kind.Rfen
        lab.rfen = new_rfen(lab.values)
        return "RFEN BUILD n={size} total=" + string(lab.values.sum())
    elif kind == Kind.Sparse
        lab.sparse = new_sparse(lab.values)
        int[] lengths := []
        for row := lab.sparse.minima[]
            lengths = lengths.append(int(#row))
        return "SPARSE BUILD levels=" + string(#lengths) + " entries=" + string(lengths.sum())
    elif kind == Kind.Sqrt
        lab.sqrt = new_sqrt(lab.values, block)
        return "SQRT BUILD block={block} blocks=" + string(#lab.sqrt.tags)
    lab.persist = new_persistent(lab.values)
    return "PERSIST BUILD nodes=" + string(#lab.persist.position) + " distinct=" + string(#lab.persist.domain) + " valuenodes=" + string(#lab.persist.counts)

Report query_array(Lab &lab, Kind kind, Span span, version := 0)
    if kind == Kind.Seg
        answer := segment_query(lab.segment, 1, Span(0, lab.segment.size - 1), span)
        return Report(operation_text(lab.segment.operation, true) + "={answer.value} visited={answer.visited}", [answer.value])
    elif kind == Kind.Lazy
        counts := Counts()
        value := lazy_query(&lab.lazy, 1, Span(0, lab.lazy.size - 1), span, &counts)
        return Report(aggregate_text(value) + " visited={counts.visited} pushes={counts.pushes}", [value.sum, value.minimum, value.maximum])
    elif kind == Kind.Sparse
        return sparse_query(lab.sparse, span)
    elif kind == Kind.Sqrt
        answer := sqrt_query(lab.sqrt, span)
        return Report("sum={answer.sum} whole={answer.whole} cells={answer.cells}", [answer.sum])
    Answer answer
    if kind == Kind.Fen
        answer = bit_range(lab.fen.bit, span)
    elif kind == Kind.Rfen
        answer = rfen_range(lab.rfen, span)
    else
        answer = pool_query(lab.persist.position, lab.persist.roots[version], Span(0, lab.persist.size - 1), span)
    return Report("sum={answer.value} visited={answer.visited}", [answer.value])

string[] dump(const Lab lab, Kind kind)
    size := int(#lab.values)
    string[] rows := []
    if kind == Kind.Seg or kind == Kind.Lazy
        heading := if kind == Kind.Seg then "SEG DUMP " + operation_text(lab.segment.operation) else "LAZY DUMP"
        rows = rows.append(heading + " nodes={2 * size - 1}")
        bounds := node_bounds(size)
        for index := bounds.indices()[]
            span := bounds[index]
            if span.right < 0
                continue
            prefix := "NODE {index} {span.left} {span.right} "
            if kind == Kind.Seg
                rows = rows.append(prefix + string(lab.segment.nodes[index]))
            else
                LazyNode node := lab.lazy.nodes[index]
                assignment := "-"
                match node.assignment
                    int value
                        assignment = string(value)
                    none
                        assignment = "-"
                rows = rows.append(prefix + aggregate_text(node.value) + " assign={assignment} add={node.addition}")
    elif kind == Kind.Fen
        rows = ["FEN DUMP n={size}", "T " + numbers(lab.fen.bit.tree[1:])]
    elif kind == Kind.Rfen
        rows = ["RFEN DUMP n={size}", "B1 " + numbers(lab.rfen.first.tree[1:]), "B2 " + numbers(lab.rfen.second.tree[1:])]
    elif kind == Kind.Sparse
        rows = ["SPARSE DUMP levels=" + string(#lab.sparse.minima)]
        for level := lab.sparse.minima.indices()[]
            rows = rows.append("MIN {level} " + numbers(lab.sparse.minima[level]))
            rows = rows.append("MAX {level} " + numbers(lab.sparse.maxima[level]))
    elif kind == Kind.Sqrt
        Sqrt tree := lab.sqrt
        rows = ["SQRT DUMP block={tree.block} blocks=" + string(#tree.tags)]
        for block := tree.tags.indices()[]
            first := int(block) * tree.block
            ending := math.min(size, first + tree.block)
            rows = rows.append("BLOCK {block} {first} {ending - 1} add={tree.tags[block]} sum={tree.sums[block]} " + numbers(tree.values[first:<ending]))
    elif kind == Kind.Grid
        rows = ["GRID DUMP rows={lab.grid.height} cols={lab.grid.width}"]
        for: 1 <= int row <= lab.grid.height
            rows = rows.append("ROW {row} " + numbers(lab.grid.tree[row][1:]))
    return rows

string[] check_all(Lab &lab, Span span)
    values := lab.values[span.left:span.right]
    direct := aggregate(values)
    common := 0
    for value := values[]
        common = gcd(common, value)
    rows := ["CHECK {span.left} {span.right} " + aggregate_text(direct) + " gcd={common}"]
    ok := 0
    different := 0
    names := kinds()
    for: 0 <= index < 7
        if not lab.built[index]
            continue
        kind := names[index]
        expected := [direct.sum]
        if kind == Kind.Seg
            match lab.segment.operation
                Operation.Sum
                    expected = [direct.sum]
                Operation.Min
                    expected = [direct.minimum]
                Operation.Max
                    expected = [direct.maximum]
                Operation.Gcd
                    expected = [common]
        elif kind == Kind.Lazy
            expected = [direct.sum, direct.minimum, direct.maximum]
        elif kind == Kind.Sparse
            expected = [direct.minimum, direct.maximum]
        version := if kind == Kind.Persist then int(#lab.persist.roots) - 1 else 0
        answer := query_array(&lab, kind, span, version)
        verdict := "DIFF"
        if answer.values == expected
            ok += 1
            verdict = "OK"
        else
            different += 1
        prefix := if kind == Kind.Persist then "version={version} " else ""
        rows = rows.append(kind_text(kind) + " {verdict} " + prefix + answer.text)
    return rows.append("RESULT ok={ok} diff={different}")

string[] mo(const int[] values, const Span[] queries)
    size := int(#values)
    count := int(#queries)
    block := integer_sqrt(size)
    int[] keys := []
    for index := queries.indices()[]
        span := queries[index]
        group := span.left / block
        end_key := if group % 2 == 0 then span.right else size - 1 - span.right
        keys = keys.append((group * size + end_key) * count + int(index))
    domain := unique_sorted(values)
    int[] ranks := []
    for value := values[]
        ranks = ranks.append(rank_of(domain, value))
    frequency := array(#domain, fill = 0)
    answers := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    int[] order := []
    left := 0
    right := -1
    moves := 0
    distinct_count := 0
    for key := keys.sorted()[]
        index := key % count
        span := queries[index]
        order = order.append(index + 1)
        moves += math.abs(span.left - left) + math.abs(span.right - right)
        while left > span.left
            left -= 1
            rank := ranks[left]
            if frequency[rank] == 0
                distinct_count += 1
            frequency[rank] += 1
        while right < span.right
            right += 1
            rank := ranks[right]
            if frequency[rank] == 0
                distinct_count += 1
            frequency[rank] += 1
        while left < span.left
            rank := ranks[left]
            frequency[rank] -= 1
            if frequency[rank] == 0
                distinct_count -= 1
            left += 1
        while right > span.right
            rank := ranks[right]
            frequency[rank] -= 1
            if frequency[rank] == 0
                distinct_count -= 1
            right -= 1
        answers[index] = distinct_count
    rows := ["MO queries={count} block={block} moves={moves}", "ORDER " + numbers(order)]
    for index := queries.indices()[]
        span := queries[index]
        rows = rows.append("ANSWER {index + 1} {span.left} {span.right} distinct={answers[index]}")
    return rows

void | error check_index(int size, int index)
    if index < 0 or index >= size
        return error("BAD INDEX {index}")
    return void

Span | error check_range(int size, int left, int right)
    try check_index(size, left)
    try check_index(size, right)
    if left > right
        return error("BAD RANGE {left} {right}")
    return Span(left, right)

void | error check_version(const Persistent tree, int version)
    if version < 0 or version >= int(#tree.roots)
        return error("BAD VERSION {version}")
    return void

void | error check_cell(const Grid grid, int row, int column)
    if row < 0 or row >= grid.height or column < 0 or column >= grid.width
        return error("BAD CELL {row} {column}")
    return void

Operation | error parse_operation(string word)
    Operation[] operations := [Operation.Sum, Operation.Min, Operation.Max, Operation.Gcd]
    for operation := operations[]
        if operation_text(operation) == word
            return operation
    return error("BAD OP " + word)

void change_values(int[] &values, Span span, int value, bool assign)
    for: span.left <= index <= span.right
        if assign
            values[index] = value
        else
            values[index] += value

string[] | error execute(Lab &lab, string line)
    words := line.split(" ")
    command := words[0]
    size := int(#lab.values)
    if command == "LOAD"
        removed := 0
        for: 0 <= index < 7
            if lab.built[index]
                removed += 1
        Grid saved := lab.grid
        bool grid_built := lab.built[7]
        lab = Lab(parsed(words[1:]))
        lab.grid = saved
        lab.built[7] = grid_built
        return ["LOAD n=" + string(#lab.values) + " removed={removed}"]
    elif command == "RESET"
        lab.values = lab.original
        Operation operation := lab.segment.operation
        int block := lab.sqrt.block
        names := kinds()
        rebuilt := 0
        for: 0 <= index < 7
            if lab.built[index]
                build_array(&lab, names[index], operation, block)
                rebuilt += 1
        return ["RESET rebuilt={rebuilt}"]
    elif command == "ARRAY" or command == "CHECK"
        span := try check_range(size, int(words[1]), int(words[2]))
        if command == "CHECK"
            return check_all(&lab, span)
        return ["ARRAY {span.left} {span.right} " + numbers(lab.values[span.left:span.right])]
    elif command == "MO"
        Span[] queries := []
        for: 1 <= index < int(#words) step 2
            queries = queries.append(try check_range(size, int(words[index]), int(words[index + 1])))
        return mo(lab.values, queries)
    Kind kind := Kind.Seg
    for candidate := kinds()[]
        if kind_text(candidate) == command
            kind = candidate
            break
    action := words[1]
    if action == "BUILD"
        Operation operation := Operation.Sum
        block := 1
        if kind == Kind.Seg
            operation = try parse_operation(words[2])
        elif kind == Kind.Sqrt
            block = if #words == 3 then int(words[2]) else integer_sqrt(size)
            if block > size
                return error("BAD BLOCK {block}")
        elif kind == Kind.Grid
            height := int(words[2])
            width := int(words[3])
            count := int(#words) - 4
            if count != height * width
                return error("BAD COUNT {count} {height * width}")
            values := parsed(words[4:])
            lab.grid = new_grid(height, width, values)
            lab.built[7] = true
            return ["GRID BUILD rows={height} cols={width} total=" + string(values.sum())]
        return [build_array(&lab, kind, operation, block)]
    if not lab.built[kind_index(kind)]
        return error("NOT BUILT " + command)
    if action == "DUMP"
        return dump(lab, kind)
    arguments := parsed(words[2:])
    if kind == Kind.Grid
        row := arguments[0]
        column := arguments[1]
        try check_cell(lab.grid, row, column)
        if action == "ADD"
            visited := grid_add(&lab.grid, row, column, arguments[2])
            return [line + " visited={visited}"]
        bottom := arguments[2]
        right := arguments[3]
        try check_cell(lab.grid, bottom, right)
        if row > bottom or column > right
            return error("BAD RECT " + numbers(arguments))
        first := grid_prefix(lab.grid, bottom + 1, right + 1)
        second := grid_prefix(lab.grid, row, right + 1)
        third := grid_prefix(lab.grid, bottom + 1, column)
        fourth := grid_prefix(lab.grid, row, column)
        sum := first.value - second.value - third.value + fourth.value
        visited := first.visited + second.visited + third.visited + fourth.visited
        return [line + " sum={sum} visited={visited}"]
    if kind == Kind.Persist
        if action == "NODES"
            return ["PERSIST NODES versions=" + string(#lab.persist.roots) + " position=" + string(#lab.persist.position) + " value=" + string(#lab.persist.counts)]
        if action == "KTH"
            span := try check_range(size, arguments[0], arguments[1])
            k := arguments[2]
            if k < 1 or k > span.right - span.left + 1
                return error("BAD K {k}")
            answer := persistent_kth(lab.persist, span, k)
            return [line + " value={answer.value} visited={answer.visited}"]
        version := arguments[0]
        try check_version(lab.persist, version)
        if action == "SET"
            index := arguments[1]
            try check_index(size, index)
            before := int(#lab.persist.position)
            root := pool_fork(&lab.persist.position, lab.persist.roots[version], Span(0, size - 1), index, arguments[2], false)
            next := int(#lab.persist.roots)
            lab.persist.roots = lab.persist.roots.append(root)
            created := int(#lab.persist.position) - before
            return [line + " version={next} created={created}"]
        span := try check_range(size, arguments[1], arguments[2])
        answer := query_array(&lab, kind, span, version)
        return [line + " " + answer.text]
    if kind == Kind.Fen and action == "LOWER"
        for index := lab.fen.values.indices()[]
            if lab.fen.values[index] < 0
                return error("NEGATIVE {index}")
        answer := bit_lower(lab.fen.bit, arguments[0])
        index := if answer.value < 0 then "none" else string(answer.value)
        return [line + " index={index} visited={answer.visited}"]
    if kind == Kind.Seg and action == "UPDATE"
        index := arguments[0]
        try check_index(size, index)
        value := arguments[1]
        visited := segment_update(&lab.segment, 1, Span(0, size - 1), index, value)
        lab.values[index] = value
        return [line + " root={lab.segment.nodes[1]} visited={visited}"]
    if kind == Kind.Fen and (action == "ADD" or action == "PREFIX")
        index := arguments[0]
        try check_index(size, index)
        if action == "ADD"
            value := arguments[1]
            visited := bit_add(&lab.fen.bit, index + 1, value)
            lab.fen.values[index] += value
            lab.values[index] += value
            return [line + " visited={visited}"]
        answer := bit_prefix(lab.fen.bit, index + 1)
        return [line + " sum={answer.value} visited={answer.visited}"]
    span := try check_range(size, arguments[0], arguments[1])
    if action == "ADD" or action == "ASSIGN"
        value := arguments[2]
        assign := action == "ASSIGN"
        string details
        if kind == Kind.Lazy
            counts := Counts()
            lazy_update(&lab.lazy, 1, Span(0, size - 1), span, value, assign, &counts)
            details = "visited={counts.visited} covered={counts.covered} pushes={counts.pushes}"
        elif kind == Kind.Rfen
            details = "visited=" + string(rfen_add(&lab.rfen, span, value))
        else
            answer := sqrt_add(&lab.sqrt, span, value)
            details = "whole={answer.whole} cells={answer.cells}"
        change_values(&lab.values, span, value, assign)
        return [line + " " + details]
    answer := query_array(&lab, kind, span)
    return [line + " " + answer.text]
